versionRationale: Initial fixed P9.4 workload. Q1 preserves single-document contracts and measures 64 MiB as 16 valid 4 MiB TXT documents. Thresholds are design targets, not measured universal guarantees.

qualification.cold: First request per fresh process/connection; no claim of flushed OS/PostgreSQL caches.
qualification.warm: Subsequent requests in the same process and connection.
qualification.monetaryCost: unknown without operator tariff; report measured CPU ms, provider calls and tokens separately
